items.title: How Long Can Rocket Lab Stock Wait On Neutron?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) has fallen about 49% over the past three months, while signing the biggest launch contract in its history. The risk sits in the gap between those two facts. The threat is not on the demand side. It is that the company spends far ahead of Neutron, the rocket meant to turn its cash around, and Neutron has not flown.

items.title: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) Deepens Its Role In Navy Electronic Warfare Program
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) awarded Marotta Controls a contract to support the U.S. Navy's Next Generation Jammer, Low Band program for airborne electronic warfare. The agreement centers on critical hardware for the NGJ-LB pod that will equip Navy aircraft with advanced jamming capability. items.title: NASA Is About to Launch a Telescope. What That Means for SpaceX, Others.
items.summary: Space is recapturing Americans’ imagination, mainly thanks to  SpaceX  Elon Musk, and his trillion-dollar dreams to make humans a multi-planetary species.  There’s more to space than just SpaceX, which will benefit other shares beyond Musk’s rocket and AI company.  On Sunday, NASA is scheduled to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
